notes: REQ-2.2 builds on the REQ-2.1 home page at /. The 'Take a note' composer (role=button, aria-label 'Take a note', visible hint 'Take a note...') is in the served HTML. Clicking it (or pressing Enter while focused) expands the editor in place: an <input type="text" id="note-title" aria-label="Title" placeholder="Title"> and a <textarea id="note-content" aria-label="Take a note" placeholder="Take a note...">, plus a 'Pin' toggle button and a 'Close' submit button. Closing the editor (submit 'Close' button, or Escape) autosaves via POST /api/notes (existing REQ-2.1 endpoint, reused unchanged): if title or content is non-empty the note is created server-side and prepended to the notes list; the editor collapses back to the 'Take a note' hint. The acceptance test clicks 'Take a note', fills Title and content (getByLabel(/title/i), getByLabel(/take a note/i)), clicks 'Close', and expects 'Weekend plan' visible in the notes list. Key detail: while the form is open the #composer container removes its role/tabindex/aria-label attributes so getByLabel(/take a note/i) resolves to the textarea, not the container div; attributes are restored when the composer collapses. Guard: clicking the composer background while the form is already open no longer re-creates (and wipes) the form. No new routes, no backend changes; seed and API surface identical to REQ-2.1.
